proposals.title: Item 5: Shareholder Proposal – Amend Certificate of Incorporation to Convert to a Public Benefit Corporation
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the Board amend the certificate of incorporation and bylaws to convert the company into a public benefit corporation balancing shareholder, stakeholder and public benefit interests.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors' Statement in Opposition We believe that BlackRock already operates in a manner that considers the interests of its shareholders and other stakeholders
